explanation: This test case only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not check that the FX rate is locked at the moment of initiation (fx_lock), nor does it verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval).
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Verify dual approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the FX rate is not locked at initiation and fluctuates during processing would not be caught. Also, a bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited would not be detected. Finally, the lack of enforcement of dual approval for large top-ups would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up process including FX rate lock, credit-before-debit, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Verify system requests second business owner approval before settlement
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: For a top-up of SGD 500, wallet balance increases by SGD 500 and FX rate is locked at initiation; funding source is debited only after wallet is credited. For a top-up of SGD 15,000, second business owner approval is required before settlement.
